facts.statement: DemoCo and Acme Corp executed Order Form #OF-2026-0142 dated 2026-01-01 under an MSA of the same date.
Total contract value is 300,000 USD, billed 100% upfront.
The subscription term is 24 months, 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31, non-cancellable except for uncured material breach.
The order form lists three components: hosted SaaS subscription (200,000 USD), implementation services (55,000 USD), and premium support (45,000 USD).
Implementation services consist of configuration, data migration, and training, performed once and expected to complete within 90 days of the contract date.
The price book lists a standalone selling price of 240,000 USD for the 24-month hosted SaaS subscription.
The price book lists a standalone selling price of 75,000 USD for the implementation services package.
The price book lists a standalone selling price of 60,000 USD for 24 months of premium support.
